objective: Author spells, powers, casting methods, resources and magic/supernatural-system packages over existing owners without creating a parallel magic runtime.
acceptance: magic-system definitions cannot invent runtime casting authority
boundaries: MRCS-01/03/04/05/08 remain the workspace, guided-authoring, bounded-expression, mechanical-definition and package-composition foundations consumed by this tranche.

Spell, power, casting-method, resource and magic/supernatural-system records remain reusable definitions/packages; existing magic/supernatural, Action/Event, Resource and gameplay runtime owners retain execution authority.
MRCS may compose governed mechanical definitions, bounded expressions and owner references but cannot execute casts, resolve outcomes, spend live resources or mutate Character/runtime state.
Casting requirements, costs, targets, effects, conditions and resource semantics remain explicit owner references or definition data and cannot silently become a second universal magic engine.
Unknown magic/source semantics remain unresolved rather than inferred from prose or neighboring definitions.
MRCS-12+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
MSAS and MVPS lane state remains independent.
